newer_changes_search: Web search for post-July-2026 VB-G RAM G changes: multiple outlets (The Hindu via Vision IAS, Outlook, Rural Voice, SCC Online 06-07-2026, Vikaspedia citing the portal) report that the Ministry of Rural Development notified revised state-wise wage rates under the Act effective 1 July 2026, with a Rs 300 per day interim base wage (national average about Rs 327 vs Rs 299 under MGNREGA). I could not open the PIB release itself. Act commencement on 1 July 2026 and 125 days are confirmed. No information found on Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card issuance progress.

findings.note: 'Until new wage rates are notified, the old MGNREGA wage rates apply' (fact quoted from the May 2026 FAQ) is out of date: new wage rates under the Act were notified effective 1 July 2026 with a Rs 300/day floor, per consistent reports. The content therefore tells users that the old rates apply when they no longer do. Same sentence in hi.
findings.suggestion: Fetch the MoRD/PIB wage-rate notification (around 30 June - 1 July 2026) as a new source, snapshot it, and replace the sentence (en + hi) with e.g. 'Wage rates are notified for each state; since 1 July 2026 no state's rate is below ₹300 a day', quoting the notification; drop or re-cite the 'existing Mahatma Gandhi NREGA wage rates shall continue' fact.

findings.note: Eligibility is per household ('rural household whose adult members volunteer'); the age rule tests the user's own age, so a 17-year-old in an eligible household sees NOT_ELIGIBLE although an adult member could apply. Acceptable for a person-level profile.
findings.suggestion: Optionally reword the rule text to 'The person asking for work must be 18 or older'.

findings.note: Both sources are PIB govt_statements (FAQ and press release), so 'guidance' is correct. The Act text (Gazette) or the operational rules would allow 'confirmed' and are the authoritative basis for the 15-day, allowance and 5 km clauses.
findings.suggestion: Add the Gazette text of the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 and any rules notified since July 2026.
